data.one_liner: A selectable container widget that shows an icon in one of its corners when tapped.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter container widget that can be toggled between selected and unselected states. When tapped, it updates its selection status and displays a customizable indicator icon on its corner.
use_when: You need a simple selectable card or container component for user selections.
You want an easy way to display checkmarks or icons on containers when tapped.
avoid_when: You require complex multi-select grid selection managers or advanced gesture recognizers.
You are looking for standard Material selection controls like CheckboxListTile or Radio.
strengths: Easy to implement and customize with background, border, and icon position properties.
weaknesses: Limited to a single-purpose container widget.
Lacks built-in group management for radio-like behavior out of the box.
